article_title: Codex 多代理编排：给 Sol 一个团队
core_theme: Codex Multi-Agent V2 的实战编排：一个协调者留在对话里，按需派出只读 scout 并行侦察，worker 实现，审批权留在用户；推理档位、上下文继承、并发预算可调
reader_takeaway: 理解「一个协调者 + 角色分工 + 可调旋钮」的编排模式，知道什么时候值得开多代理、什么时候不需要
summary_angle: 「一个团队从一次对话里长出来」：协调者留在主对话，派出的 scout 并行散开侦察，结果回传汇聚，审批权留在用户

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文：The coordinator acts as the primary delegator: it assigns substantive work, avoids duplicate investigations, and tracks what each agent is doing
information_blocks.visual_idea: 画面中央一个对话窗口，代表始终对用户可用的协调者

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文：Send focused, read-only scouts out in parallel with reasoning_effort "low" and fork_turns "none"；并发默认四个代理
information_blocks.visual_idea: 从中央窗口发出几条细线，散到四周四个侦察点，每个点带一个小放大镜标记

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文：Bring the results together and keep approvals with the user
information_blocks.visual_idea: 细线从四周回传汇聚到中央窗口，窗口上方浮起一枚对勾，表示结果汇总、审批留用户

main_metaphor: 将帅与斥候：将帅留在原地统筹，斥候四散侦察，结果回传
primary_subject: 一个中央对话窗口（协调者）
subject_action: 从窗口发出四条细线到四周侦察点，侦察点回传汇聚，最终浮起一枚对勾
composition: 单点聚焦 + 放射状层级（中央窗口为焦点，四周侦察点对称分布）
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: low-saturation arthouse illustration, quiet composition, subtle grain, muted colors, reflective emotional tone
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中；克制的色调与安静构图契合「按需开火、不是默认全开」的克制叙事
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
draft_goal: 第一轮验证「中央协调者 + 放射侦察 + 回传对勾」的放射状结构是否可读
final_prompt:
Use the current cover direction as the base.
Keep the strongest part of the composition and preserve the summary angle: "a team grows out of one conversation" - the coordinator stays in the main chat, scouts fan out in parallel to investigate, results converge back, and approvals stay with the user.
Preserve the core metaphor: a general with scouts - the general stays in place to coordinate, scouts spread out to investigate, results come back.

Keep these information beats readable and source-grounded:
- beat 1: central chat window representing the coordinator, Chinese label 协调者
- beat 2: four thin lines fanning out to four scout points with small magnifier marks, Chinese label 并行侦察, number chip 4
- beat 3: thin lines returning and converging back to the window, small checkmark floating above, Chinese label 审批留用户

Change only these points:
- sharpen the quiet low-saturation palette and subtle grain
- make the radial structure unmistakable: lines clearly leave the central window to the scout points and clearly return and converge
- keep only the approved Chinese labels and the number chip; remove any extra text, labels or ornaments

Make the image feel more like isometric conceptual systems scene combined with this selected visual style descriptor: low-saturation arthouse illustration, quiet composition, subtle grain, muted colors, reflective emotional tone. Preserve one clear focal subject and three supporting narrative beats in a wide 2.35:1 frame. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Primary subject should remain: one central chat window sending four thin lines to scout points around it, with results converging back and a checkmark above.
Simplify the background so that only a quiet gray-blue gradient with subtle grain remains as supporting context.
Color palette: low-saturation gray-blue, off-white, one warm orange accent.

Visible text policy: keep only the approved Chinese labels 协调者, 并行侦察, 审批留用户 and the number chip 4, never more than 4 items. No poster title, no long sentence captions, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, and no fake architecture node names.
Remove any watermark, prompt residue, screenshots, dashboards, fake diagrams, fake charts, fake terminal output, fabricated metrics, unrelated icons, and decorative clutter.
Avoid meaningless code rain, floating chips, neon skyscrapers, heavy HUD overlays, fake terminal output, generic robot standing pose, English slogans, fake architecture node names.

Wide cover illustration, aspect ratio 2.35:1.
